text: This report is a status update and report back on CreateTO's 2023 objectives, work plan, and the corresponding performance objectives of the Chief Executive Officer.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Approved amendments and received for information updates to Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (January 31, 2024) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO, as part of the report back on CreateTO's 2023 work plan and the corporate objectives for the Chief Executive Officer in 2023. 2. Approved the performance evaluation of CreateTO's 2023 work plan and the corporate objectives for the Chief Executive Officer, as contained in Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (January 31, 2024) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO. 3.
